title: Enterprise Wide IT Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description:
The Office of Naval Intelligence (ONI) requires a full spectrum of lifecycle Enterprise-Wide Information Technology (EWIT) Support Services for Department of Navy (DON) and Intelligence Community (IC) customers. The attached document describes the overall support requirements, types of capabilities, and the technical and performance objectives that are required to respond to the Naval Intelligence Enterprise mission.  This effort will cover the support and infrastructure required for the systems related to collection, production, storage, analysis, exploitation, and dissemination of intelligence products and the organizations that utilize the supported architectures, data and databases, tools and applications. EWIT support services provided shall include multiple activities associated with systems and applications that fall under the responsibility of the Office of Naval Intelligence (ONI), Naval Intelligence Activity (NIA) and other Navy and Intelligence organizations. Systems and applications support will be required on multiple Department of Defense (DoD) / Intelligence Community (IC) networks, including multiple Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) networks, enterprise application support on Secret Internet Protocol Router Network (SIPRNet) and Non-classified Internet Protocol Router Network (NIPRNet), various standalone classified networks designed for threat engineering analysis and production, and various Coalition networks, within the National Maritime Intelligence Center (NMIC) and in multiple physical locations worldwide.  

 The submission of information in response to this notice will assist the Government in identifying potential small business sources. 

 A submission shall not be construed as an invitation for bid, request for quotation, request for proposal, or as an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products or services. Your response to this Sources Sought Notice will be treated as information only and part of market research and will not be shared outside of the Government. No entitlement to payment of direct or indirect costs or charges by the Government will arise as a result of contractor responses to this announcement. 

 This request does not constitute a solicitation for proposals or the authority to enter negotiations to award a contract. 

 It is requested that interested firms submit: 

 (1)  The name, address, phone number, email address, and CAGE code of the firm; 

 (2)  A capabilities statement including a summary of their product/service and experience similar to the requirements of the PWS (no more than 10 pages) 

 (3)  Confirmation of Small Business Status 

  

 Please restrict all responses to non-proprietary information, and be advised that all submissions become Government property and will not be returned. 

 All responses shall be sent to John Lowney via email at john.c.lowney.civ@us.navy.mil 

 All email responses must include the following subject line: EWIT Sources Sought Response – [Insert Company Name].
